verdict.rationale: A framework like Docusaurus could reasonably publish a versioned plugin/config API with a deprecation policy, so this axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a deprecation policy or API versioning guarantees. The document-versioning CLI (docusaurus-docs-6/19) versions the user's own documentation content, which is an adjacent feature. The v1→v2 rewrite note (docusaurus-docs-16) does not document any deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
